subject: English
question_text: Use capitals and punctuation marks where necessary in the following text:
stimulus: why are you going to barishal said father i want to buy some important books said saad do you need money yes father dont go alone as time is not going well Part B : Composition (40 Marks)
guide_solution: "Why are you going to Barishal?" said father. "I want to buy some important books," said Saad. "Do you need money?" "Yes, father." "Don't go alone as time is not going well."
